sop.title: Service types, booking cut-offs and delivery deadlines
sop.keywords: 1 hour rush 3 hour express same day next day specific slot round trip cut-off last booking deadline night surcharge
body: 1 Hour Rush / Night: delivered within 1 hr of pickup. Bookable 24/7; night surcharge 11pm–7am.
3 Hours Express: pickup and delivery within 3 hrs. Last booking 8pm, completed by 11pm.
Same Day: pickup and delivery within 6 hrs. Last booking 5pm (12pm for office deliveries), completed by 11pm.
Next Day: pickup on booking day. Last booking 7pm, delivered by 11pm next day.
Specific Slot: date and time set to the minute. Last booking 6pm, delivered within ±30 mins of the slot.
2-Way Round Trip: A → B, then B → A the same day. Last booking 5pm, completed by 11pm.
When chasing drivers, go in this order: 1-hour rush → 3-hour express → same day → next day.

sop.title: Which jobs to clear first (priority order)
sop.keywords: priority order which job first pending acceptance clear sgh tiktok shopee bakes telemedical
body: Clear Pending Acceptance in this order: SGH (never outsource, refer to Hamyzan) → TikTok → Shopee/Lazada → bakes and cooked food → telemedical → normal customers.
Priority order jobs (refer to Philip), 1-hr rush, 3-hr express and non-movables must never lapse or expire.
Check that 1-hr rush and 3-hr express jobs are picked up and delivered within the timeslot.
sop.escalate: Priority order jobs → Philip. SGH → Hamyzan.

sop.title: How to work the At Risk Dashboard
sop.keywords: at risk dashboard monitoring late pickup late delivery rookie agent check track
body: On the At Risk Dashboard: assign the job to yourself, contact the agent, then mark it checked with a reason.
Check rookie agents only. Subcons, fleet, Gold and Platinum agents are skipped.
Late pickup (30 mins left in the pickup window): track the agent and WhatsApp for an ETA. If the agent is missing, block the agent; ask the seller to push the time, or Lalamove a non-movable job.
Late delivery (30+ mins over): if the agent is far, WhatsApp for an ETA. No reply → flag it in the group chat.
sop.escalate: Agent MIA or unresolved over 1 shift → Philip (Fulfilment lead).

sop.title: Checking PUIP (pickup in progress) jobs and ETAs
sop.keywords: puip pickup in progress eta gps far from pickup no answer remove outsource cliq
body: Check all PUIP jobs with ETAs and post follow-ups in Cliq.
Agent does not answer, or GPS shows them far from the pickup → remove the agent, then move the job to the next slot if it is movable, or outsource it.
Shopee/Lazada: PUIP check at 11.30am. TikTok: update PUIP ETAs in Cliq every 30–45 mins from 1–3.30pm; full PUIP check at 6pm (afternoon) and 7.30pm (evening).
Telemedical: check PUIP and Item Picked Up jobs on the At Risk Dashboard hourly from 10am.

sop.title: Fixed times to check late pickups and late deliveries
sop.keywords: late pickup check time late delivery check shopee lazada 11.15 2.30 4pm 7.30
body: Shopee/Lazada: AM late pickups at 11.15am; AM late deliveries at 2.30pm; PM late pickups at 4pm; PM late deliveries at 7.30pm.
TikTok: watch afternoon routes 5.30–7.30pm and evening routes 8–10.30pm; warn buyers of a late delivery before they chase.
Telemedical: hourly At Risk check from 10am so there are no late pickups or deliveries.

sop.title: Closing jobs at end of day (Lalamove, LLM, move-over)
sop.keywords: close lalamove job close llm end of shift 11pm move-over file reverted file overtime
body: Close every Lalamove job the same day. Attach POD only if it was on time.
9.45pm: close all Lalamove jobs. 10–11pm: close all Lalamove and LLM jobs and any morning/afternoon jobs not yet closed.
End of day: update the Move-over and Reverted files.
11pm: every job is closed before the shift ends. At least 1 CS stays until all jobs are closed; anyone staying back is logged for OT.

sop.title: Start-of-shift clean-up (8.30am)
sop.keywords: 8.30am morning expired jobs open lalamove unanswered whatsapp undelivered item picked last 5 days non-repostable
body: At 8.30am clear: expired jobs, open Lalamove jobs, unanswered WhatsApp, undelivered or item-picked jobs from the last 5 days, and non-repostable cancellations.
9–10am: identify moved-over jobs and make them the priority to clear the same day.
From 10am, every 2–3 hrs: check non-repostable, expired and expiring jobs.

sop.title: A job is still in Pending Acceptance — what do I do?
sop.keywords: pending acceptance not accepted no driver no taker unaccepted find a driver top up
body: 1. Call drivers already en route nearby and use Find a Driver.
2. Leftover jobs: give them to an agent already assigned and heading to the same cluster, zone, postal sector or collection point (same seller).
3. Top up in steps (see Top-up rules) until the fee matches the outsource cost, no later than 30 mins before the pickup window ends.
4. Still no taker: match the Lalamove price in uParcel for 10 mins, send a notification and push to Urgent.
5. Still no taker: movable job → move to the next slot/day and log it in the Move-over file. Non-movable → outsource via the Lalamove API in the Admin portal.
Never outsource SGH jobs — refer them to Hamyzan. TikTok jobs are never moved to the next day.

sop.title: Top-up rules
sop.keywords: top up how much top-up step auto top-up low priority $1 $2 tip outsource cost
body: Auto top-up covers important customers. Manual top-up only after auto top-up ends, always in steps.
Top up gradually by priority until the fee matches the outsource cost, no later than 30 mins before the end of the pickup timeslot.
Medical and e-commerce: $2 steps after auto top-up. Medical at night: top up until it matches the outsource cost, by 8.30pm at the latest.
TikTok: top up from $1 in steps against the Lalamove price (3.30–4.30pm afternoon; after 6pm evening).
Bakes, cakes and non-movables: match the Lalamove price every 10 mins from 11am.
Shopee urgent same-day (cakes, bread, cooked food, fresh meat/seafood): mark Urgent, extend to 3 hrs, top up to $8 max, tell Fulfilment.
Low-priority customers: no top-up. Customer may tip or rebook. On a written complaint, $1–2 max.

sop.title: When and how to outsource to Lalamove
sop.keywords: lalamove outsource last resort api admin portal urgent notification
body: Lalamove is the last resort on the assignment ladder.
1. Check in-house drivers first.
2. Match the Lalamove price in uParcel for 10 mins, send a notification, push to Urgent.
3. Only then outsource — through the Lalamove API in the Admin portal only.
4. Close every Lalamove job the same day. Attach POD only if on time.
Never outsource SGH jobs. Cakes and bakes go via the Lalamove API.
sop.escalate: Outsourcing approval → Philip; TikTok afternoon outsourcing approved by Faiq, evening by Senior CS.

sop.title: Moving a job to the next slot or day (move-over)
sop.keywords: move over next day movable non-movable reschedule moveover file buyer
body: Only movable jobs may be moved. Never move: medical/telemedical, SGH (without Hamyzan), TikTok, bakes/cakes/cooked food, or other non-movables.
Shopee/Lazada AM: at 11.45am move movable AM jobs to PM — call buyers, update sellers, check PUIP. No jobs may expire after 12pm.
Shopee/Lazada PM: 4.30–5pm move movable Pending Acceptance jobs to the next day and log them in the Move-over file. Zero Pending Acceptance by 5pm.
Shopee may roll up to 5% of jobs (movables only). Lazada must hit 100%.
Update the Move-over file at end of day.

sop.title: Zero-Pending-Acceptance deadlines by account
sop.keywords: deadline zero pending acceptance by when outsource by 5pm 6pm 7pm 7.30pm tiktok shopee sgh tsuklio
body: Shopee/Lazada: outsource non-movables by 4.30pm; zero Pending Acceptance by 5pm.
TikTok afternoon: outsource by 5pm; zero Pending Acceptance by 6pm.
TikTok evening: outsource by 7pm; zero Pending Acceptance by 7.30pm; all evening pickups done by 8pm.
SGH same-day: all assigned, zero Pending Acceptance by 1–2pm and again 4–5pm.
Tsuklio: all assigned by 2pm; drivers at 28 Tai Seng by 3pm.
Telemedical: night duty from 7.30pm; Minmed not accepted by 8.30pm → Lalamove; all delivered by 9pm.

sop.title: Jobs picked up from 6 Defu South St 1 #05-24 (uParcel warehouse)
sop.keywords: warehouse job defu 05-24 denzel expired cancel
body: Any job picked up from 6 Defu South St 1 #05-24 is a uParcel warehouse job, whatever customer name is on it.
Never cancel a warehouse job.
If a warehouse job expires or is not accepted, flag it at once to the Ops team, the Fulfilment team or Denzel.

sop.title: Recipient not around to receive
sop.keywords: no one home recipient not around cannot contact left at door safe spot perishable medical
body: Agent calls the customer and keeps the call log.
Perishables: leave somewhere safe and take all 3 PODs (waybill, item with unit number, where it was left). Send the photo to the customer and write where it was left in the remarks.
Medical items: agent must contact CS. Medical items are never left unattended without the PIN.
TikTok perishables: one attempt only; if it fails, leave at the door with proof (WhatsApp or POD showing where).

sop.title: Location cannot be accessed / undelivered
sop.keywords: cannot access location undelivered return next working day returned status condo restricted
body: Agent calls the customer and keeps the call log.
Update the job to Undelivered with photo proof and the call log.
Return the item the next working day and update the job to Returned with photo proof.
Items go back to the sender when: customer can't be contacted and location can't be accessed; a medical item and the customer hasn't advised how to receive it; or the address is in a restricted area.
TikTok non-perishables: one re-attempt within 2 working days, then return to seller (return fee to driver). POD and call logs uploaded before marking undelivered.

sop.title: Failed pickup: seller closed, item not ready, or under-declared
sop.keywords: failed pickup seller closed parcel not ready under-declared cancel reason 50% fee waiting
body: Seller closed: agent calls the seller and CS, keeps the call log and a photo, then cancels with reason 'Arrived but seller closed' with the photo and call log as POD.
Items can't be located: cancel with reason 'Parcel not ready' with proof photo and call log.
Under-declared: agent contacts CS, cancels with reason 'Parcel under-declared' with a photo of the item.
A 50% cancellation fee applies when the agent arrived and the item was not ready / wrong address / under-declared. Cancel with the correct status; the customer must acknowledge the fee first.
TikTok failed pickup (seller's fault) = 50% fee: waiting over 15 mins, item not packed (10-min allowance), shop closed, wrong waybill, nobody present.

sop.title: Reverted status
sop.keywords: reverted status revert file seller track delivered returned
body: Verify with the seller, inform Ops, log it in the Revert file, and track the job until it is Delivered or Returned.

sop.title: Wrong item handed over (TikTok)
sop.keywords: wrong item handed over return within 4 hours tiktok
body: Return within 4 hrs of the slot end (e.g. 3.30–7.30pm slot → by 11.30pm). If the seller is closed, the next working day.

sop.title: What a valid POD must show
sop.keywords: pod proof of delivery photo waybill unit number doorstep valid reject
body: Every POD must show #1 the full waybill/label and #2 the item with the unit number in view (matching #1).
If no one receives, #3 is also required: the item and where it was left.
Good lighting, no blur, whole parcel in frame. Improper PODs result in claims if the agent is found liable.
SGH ambient: POD shows the unit number. SGH cold chain: cooler box at the unit, data logger at 2–8°C, and the recipient; hand over in person only.

sop.title: TikTok rules
sop.keywords: tiktok timeslot afternoon evening penalty late pickup $15 wrong status repost weight 30kg stacking 4 hours
body: 100% fulfilment; no TikTok job is ever moved to the next day — if capacity is short, outsource.
Afternoon: pickup 3–6.30pm, delivery 3.30–7.30pm. Evening: pickup 5.30–8pm, delivery 6.30–10.30pm.
Delivery deadline: 4 hrs from pickup. Over 4 hrs is a breach regardless of timeslot.
Penalties: late pickup $15/job; wrong status update $15/job (recovered from the agent).
Max 30 kg / 200 cm; over- or under-declared → raise to TikTok at once. Max 10 drops per slot unless subcon/regular driver.
Never repost in admin — the TikTok API reposts. If a cancellation was valid, flag it to TikTok and delete the job in admin when told.

sop.title: Working TikTok Tokgistic tickets
sop.keywords: tokgistic ticket tiktok consultation complaint compensation pend refuse solve lark
body: Tickets come through Tokgistic (partner.tokgistic.com); enquiries through Lark (selected members, SLA 24 hrs).
Consultation: resolve within 24 hrs. Complaint (late delivery/pickup, damage): 2 working days. Compensation: 5 working days.

1. Take the ticket from Open tickets in my group. 2. Investigate with POD, GPS and call logs; attach evidence. 3. Use Pend while waiting. 4. On complaints, Confirm or Refuse responsibility — a refusal needs a structured reason. 5. Mark as solved.
Log TikTok claims (liable / not liable) in the Top up / Internal Claims file.

sop.title: Shopee / Lazada rules
sop.keywords: shopee lazada collection 2-5pm delivery 3-7pm cut-off 9pm 95% 100% ushop mustafa dingtalk
body: Collection 2–5pm, delivery 3–7pm. Booking cut-off 9pm (Shopee later → day after next).
Lazada target 100%. Shopee ≥95% (5% movables may move 1 day; non-movables excluded).
Ushop and Mustafa follow the Lazada rules: complete the same day; cancel only if necessary.
Urgent and move-over Shopee jobs may be outsourced the same day.
Lazada via DingTalk (as soon as received, SLA 24 hrs); escalation tickets and confirmation portal within 48 hrs. Shopee escalation tickets: first response within 2 hrs.

sop.title: Shopee seller/buyer requests (reschedule, bring forward, returns, address change)
sop.keywords: shopee reschedule bring forward already accepted repost cancel return address change admin cancel
body: Bring forward same day: no top-up; returns to the original date when the slot expires.
Reschedule ≥1 day ahead: log in the Move-over sheet; treat as a first attempt on the new date.
Already accepted: not rescheduled — advise the seller to decline the buyer's request.
Repost after customer cancel or failed pickup: seller reposts. If the agent used a wrong reason, repost and block the agent.
Agent cancels for other reasons: auto-reposted; if not, report to IT. Admin cancel: always with remarks.
Returns: return status = Shopee cancels; no repost. Same-day seller return and recipient-initiated returns carry a fee. Agents may not refuse.
Address change: before acceptance only, unless the agent agrees.

sop.title: SGH (key account) rules
sop.keywords: sgh hospital cold chain pin hamyzan never outsource vivance
body: SGH jobs are never outsourced and never moved to another day without Hamyzan. Any SGH job still pending goes to Hamyzan.
Cold chain PIN: release only after the agent sends a photo showing an identifiable recipient present. All PINs: POD must confirm hand delivery via WhatsApp or KChat.
Reject SGH PODs missing the unit number, cooler box, logger reading or recipient; flag to Hamyzan.
Undeliverable cold chain → return to HQ. Vivance SGH follows SGH rules.

sop.title: Telemedical rules (HMI, Minmed, Alliance, Parkway, CGH, KTPH, Noah)
sop.keywords: telemedical medical minmed alliance noah health clinic 9pm pin never moved
body: Medical jobs are never moved; every telemedical job is delivered the same day by 9pm.
Minmed: hourly bookings only, no stacking. Pickup within 30 mins of acceptance or block the agent. Not accepted by 8.30pm → Lalamove. PIN comes from the patient only; never leave unattended.
Alliance: 3-hr jobs strictly within 9am–12pm or 1–4pm.
Noah Health: deliver within 4 hrs (max 1 hr late). Tell the patient the delivery window; no extensions.
PIN requests: POD must confirm hand delivery via WhatsApp or KChat.

sop.title: Corporate accounts and priority bakes/F&B sellers
sop.keywords: corporate tsuklio gfk vivance bioskin cat fiddle lady m bakes cakes non-movable priority sellers
body: Tsuklio Bento (Hamyzan): all jobs assigned by 2pm; drivers at 28 Tai Seng by 3pm.
Project jobs (Bioskin & Sinda, Aster Mobility, Tan Cheong, Plasmidsaurus): Ira.
Key F&B (Cat & Fiddle, Lady M, Novita): Philip; perishables.
Priority non-movable sellers: Vanda Paws, Cat & Fiddle, Venchi, Swensen's, Take a Bake, eCreative, Mdm Ling, Hipster Bakes, Ritz, Cookie Dealer SG, Jenna Macarons, SL Food, Shangri-La.
Bakes/cakes/cooked food: from 11am match the Lalamove price every 10 mins; Lalamove at 11.45am (AM) or 4.30pm (PM) if still unaccepted.

sop.title: Fee rules: return fee, failed pickup, 50% cancellation
sop.keywords: fee return fee failed pickup fee 50% cancellation charge customer
body: Return fee: only with the merchant's prior approval.
Failed pickup (agent arrived): one fee per location regardless of parcel count; none if only 1 of a batch failed.

50% cancellation fee: agent arrived and the item was not ready / wrong address / under-declared. Cancel with the correct status; the customer acknowledges the fee first. TikTok includes a 15+ min wait.
sop.escalate: Refunds and payout disputes → Mabeline Xie (CFO).

sop.title: Late delivery partial refund
sop.keywords: late delivery refund downgrade partial refund e-wallet credit job amendment
body: Downgrade the job to the service actually achieved (e.g. a 3-hr job delivered after 5 hrs → Same Day).
Deduct the difference from the agent; credit the customer's e-wallet via a job amendment.
Note: the exact price-amendment calculation is not yet in the knowledge base. Check the amended price with your lead before confirming an amount to the customer.

sop.title: Oversized parcel
sop.keywords: oversized parcel size weight photo amend order
body: Agent uploads a size and weight photo. CS checks by shift end; admin uploads it if missing; amend the order.

sop.title: Claim procedure (damaged, lost, late) — Shopee, Lazada, corporate
sop.keywords: claim damaged lost missing broken smashed compensation investigate liable 5 days express@uparcel.sg
body: Claims must reach express@uparcel.sg within 5 calendar days of delivery; later claims are rejected.
1. Log every claim, valid or not, in the Claims file and withhold the agent's pay.
2. Admin Panel > User > Agent: set 'Have Claims?' to Yes (blocks instant cash-out).
3. Investigate: delivered within the time frame? POD and GPS valid? If not, ask the agent for POD, call logs or message logs.
4. Decide: 2 or more of POD, GPS, call logs, message logs valid → reject. 1 or fewer → accept. Late and damaged → accept, unless frozen goods were delivered within 5 hrs of pickup.
5. Invalid: reject and release pay. Valid: get the claim form (with proof of refund) from the merchant or Shopee CS; send to Finance and Shopee CS.
6. Close the case in the Claims file. Shopee pays the seller; uParcel never pays sellers directly.
sop.escalate: Unclear cases → Faiq or Carmen. Claims over the agreed limit → CFO.

sop.title: What is claimable vs not claimable
sop.keywords: claimable not claimable cake smashed frozen defrosted left at door wrong unit
body: Claimable: cake fully smashed with photo (full) or partly smashed (partial); pastries toppled (partial); frozen item delivered 5+ hrs after pickup (full, excl. non-perishables); frozen item left at door with no notification (full); wrong unit/address, unrecoverable (full).
Not claimable: frozen item defrosted though delivered on time (product issue); left at door after SMS/WhatsApp/call to recipient; left at door with pickup SMS sent via CM.com.

sop.title: Where each platform's claims arrive and are logged
sop.keywords: claims file shopee claims tracking lazada xspace tokgistic top up internal claims
body: Shopee: arrives by email → Shopee Claims Tracking file.
Lazada: arrives via the Xspace portal → update the Lazada Claims portal; liable cases in the Top up / Internal Claims file.
TikTok: arrives as a Tokgistic ticket → Top up / Internal Claims file.

sop.title: Change of date, address, email or account details
sop.keywords: change date change address change email contact details delete account amend
body: Change of date: change on the Admin portal; update the Moveover file.
Change of address: change on the Admin portal. After agent acceptance, only with the agent's agreement.
Change of email, contact or other details: request must come by email; change on Admin; update the Access Correction file.
Delete an active account: request must come by email; send the request on the Agent / Customer deletion chat; update the Access Correction file.

sop.title: Wallet top-up checks
sop.keywords: wallet top up transfer slip credit payment check
body: Check the transfer slip, amount, sender's full name and bank before crediting.

sop.title: Customer asks for a faster pickup
sop.keywords: faster pickup urgent hurry customer chasing driver tip rebook
body: Low-priority customers: advise adding a tip or rebooking. $1–2 top-up only on a written complaint.
Important customers are covered by auto top-up; manual top-up only after it ends, in steps.

sop.title: Approving agent and Partner Fleet registrations
sop.keywords: agent approval registration nric s t profile photo quiz partner fleet 7 days deletion access correction
body: Approve the same day if profile photo and quiz are complete, plus (manual applicants) an NRIC upload matching the NRIC field.
Only NRICs starting with S or T.
Message incomplete applicants; log what's needed and the due date in the profile log.
Still incomplete 7 days after the reminder: agents → request deletion on the Agent / Customer deletion chat (system auto-deletes at 30 days); Partner Fleet → delete the profile.
Update the Access Correction file.

sop.title: Rules agents must follow (pickup, cancellation, scanning)
sop.keywords: agent rules cancel ban accepted job scan waybill timeslot stacking
body: Only accept jobs you can pick up within the window; check size fits the vehicle.
All deliveries follow the timeslot unless CS says otherwise.
Cancelling an accepted job leads to a ban, except the pickup cases (seller closed, not ready, under-declared) done with CS and proof.
Scan all items against the waybill at pickup; scan again before delivery.

sop.title: Response time standards per channel
sop.keywords: response time sla chat 5 mins email 2 hrs call 15 rings whatsapp 20 mins dingtalk lark
body: Zoho Desk chats: first response within 5 mins; resolve at first contact where possible.
Zoho Desk emails: first response within 2 hrs; escalate cases needing Ops to the relevant Ops team.
Inbound calls: answer within 15 rings.
WhatsApp: first response within 20 mins.
DingTalk (Lazada) and Lark (TikTok): as soon as received; platform SLA 24 hrs.
Tokgistic: first response within 24 hrs. Shopee escalations: 2 hrs. Lazada escalations: 48 hrs.
Post every action, escalation or operational change in the SG CS Chat.

sop.title: What a complete customer reply must include
sop.keywords: reply template insufficient response how to reply customer tone complete answer
body: Greet the customer and name the job (tracking number) you checked.
State the current status and what you found (e.g. driver ETA, POD, reason for delay).
Say exactly what happens next and by when (e.g. 'driver will arrive by 4.30pm', 'we will update you by 6pm').
If a fee or refund applies, state the rule and amount, and get acknowledgement before applying a fee.
Never promise a time, refund or compensation the SOP doesn't allow. Never share internal notes, agent pay or other customers' data.
Close with a clear next step or contact, and log the action in the SG CS Chat.

sop.title: Escalation matrix — who to go to

body: Level 1 — CS / Fulfilment officer: all first-line issues, within response times.
Level 2 — Philip (Fulfilment, telemedical) or Carmen (CS); Hamyzan for SGH and Tsuklio: agent MIA, outsourcing decisions, disputes, anything unresolved over 1 shift.

body: Telemedical: Philip (Fulfilment: Shara, Anestasia, Rupert).
SGH and Vivance SGH: Hamyzan.

sop.title: Job price amendments
sop.keywords: price amendment amend price recalculate job price change vehicle extra stop waiting time
body: Not yet in the knowledge base. The SOP covers late-delivery downgrades (credit the difference via job amendment) and oversized parcels (amend the order), but not the price calculation itself.
Until this section is added: do not quote an amended price to the customer until your lead has checked it.

sop.title: Recipient absent or parcel undelivered (customer side)
sop.keywords: recipient absent not home undelivered redelivery return fee perishable left at door 3 days
body: Free re-delivery within 3 working days.
If the second attempt also fails, the parcel is returned to the sender. Return fee: the higher of $7 or 50% of the category price, plus any area surcharge.
Perishables are not re-delivered; they're left at the door with photo proof.
Agents must not leave parcels at the door without the recipient's consent (except perishables per SOP).
sop.escalate: SOP says a return fee needs the merchant's prior approval, and TikTok allows 2 working days. Confirm which applies.

sop.title: Changing the delivery address (customer side)
sop.keywords: change address wrong address delivery address new fee repost
body: Not yet accepted: cancel and repost with the right address.
Already accepted: a new delivery fee may apply. Wrong delivery address → a new delivery fee. Address change after pickup: $3 fee (agent FAQ).
Internal rule: after acceptance, change only with the agent's agreement (SOP §7.4).

sop.title: Agent payouts, commission and instant payout
sop.keywords: agent payout commission 80% 20% instant payout wallet $200 reserve blackout giro
body: Agents keep 80% of the delivery fee; uParcel keeps 20%.
Payout by GIRO: jobs on days 1–15 paid on days 22–24; days 16–31 paid on days 7–9 of the next month.

Instant payout: wallet must stay above $200; $2–$1,000 per day; $1 fee per request; one request a day; approved next working day; not during claims, frozen accounts or blackout dates (13th–16th and 29th–1st).
New agents are limited to 7 jobs until 20+ deliveries and a 4+ rating.
Late delivery: uParcel may deduct up to 50% of the fee; repeated delays lead to deactivation.

sop.title: Bulk discounts and corporate accounts
sop.keywords: bulk discount corporate account monthly billing fall-below fee 10 orders sub-account invoice credit
body: Bulk discount (same pickup date, delivery date and timing), applied automatically: 5–9 orders 5% · 10–19 orders 10% · 20–29 orders 15% · 30+ orders 20%.
Corporate account: minimum 10 orders a month; otherwise a $10/month fall-below fee (none if 0 bookings).
Corporate benefits: monthly billing with 30 days' credit, invoices with PO numbers, sub-accounts, bulk upload, Favourite Fleet.
To apply: log in and choose 'Corporate Account Request', or email express@uparcel.sg. Bulk-rate enquiries: sales@uparcel.sg.
First-booking promo code: WELCOME10 (10% off).

sop.title: Cancelling a booking
sop.keywords: cancel cancellation refund before after accepted 50% fee manpower en route
body: Before an agent accepts ('Waiting for Acceptance'): customer can cancel for a full refund to the e-wallet.

After acceptance: contact the agent, then cancel under Manage Deliveries. If the driver is en route or it's within 30 mins of pickup, a 50% delivery fee (plus 50% of any manpower fee) applies. Corporate cancellations are billed on the monthly invoice.
Example: a $10 + $0.70 GST job cancelled with 50% fee refunds $5 + $0.35.
Wrong pickup address → 50% cancellation fee. Repeated cancellations can lead to account suspension.
An older website post says the 50% fee is capped at $10; the current FAQ doesn't mention a cap.
sop.escalate: Confirm with Carmen whether the $10 cap still applies before quoting it.

sop.title: Customer claim deadline and documents (website wording)
sop.keywords: claim deadline days lost damaged written notice documents waybill invoice receipt
body: Customers must submit claims in writing to express@uparcel.sg with the original waybill, invoices/receipts and any proof requested. One claim per item.
T&C: written notice within 3 working days of delivery (or of discovering hidden damage), and no later than 5 calendar days after delivery. Supporting documents within 7 days of being asked.
Internal rule (SOP §8.1): claims later than 5 calendar days are rejected. Tell customers to claim as early as possible and within 3 working days.
Approved payouts: 7–30 days.
sop.escalate: T&C has several conflicting deadlines (48 hrs, 2 days, 3 days). Carmen to confirm the one agents should quote.

sop.title: Favourite / blocked agents (My Fleet)
sop.keywords: my fleet favourite agent block agent add remove agent customer
body: Add an agent to My Fleet by giving a positive rating and choosing 'add'. Remove under Favourite Agents → Delete.
Block an agent under Favourites → Block Agent.
Jobs go to the fleet first; if none accept within 10 minutes the job is reposted to all agents.

sop.title: Operating and customer-service hours (website)
sop.keywords: operating hours customer service hours open weekend public holiday 24/7
body: Bookings and deliveries run 24/7 including weekends and public holidays.
Website FAQ: customer service 9am–6.30pm, Monday to Sunday.
Internal shifts (SOP §7.2): AM 8.30am–5.30pm, PM 2–11pm.
sop.escalate: Website hours differ from internal shifts. Confirm what agents should tell customers.

sop.title: Insurance and maximum claim amount
sop.keywords: insurance extra cover claim maximum how much compensation $100 lost damaged value
body: Every delivery includes $100 basic cover.

Extra cover must be added before checkout: 1.2% (1 Hour Rush), 1.5% (Same Day / 3 Hours / 2-Way), 2% (Next Day / time slot). Extended cover is capped at $2,000 per shipment. Favourite Fleet can't be selected with extra insurance.
Without extra cover, compensation is the lower of the item's cost price or $100 per delivery order, with proof of value.
Parcels worth more than $2,000 are not accepted.

sop.title: Booking not accepted — what to tell the customer
sop.keywords: not accepted no agent repost tip increase acceptance rate deleted end of day
body: It means no available agent took the job. The customer can repost at a different time; unaccepted jobs are removed at the end of the day.
To improve acceptance: add a tip before payment, or to a posted job under Manage Deliveries.
Internally, CS still follows the Pending Acceptance SOP (top-ups, Lalamove) for priority accounts.

sop.title: Payment methods, top-ups and refunds
sop.keywords: payment method credit card e-wallet top up bank transfer sgqr giro refund 3.5% withdraw $2 fee expire 12 months gst
body: E-wallet (minimum top-up $50), bank transfer, SGQR, or monthly billing for corporate accounts. No cash.
One-off card (Stripe) payments: 3.5% + $0.25 fee, non-refundable.
Top-up timing: card instant; bank transfer / SGQR at least 1 working day; GIRO up to 3 working days.
Cancelled credits go to the e-wallet. Card refund on request to express@uparcel.sg; takes 14 working days.
Withdrawing e-wallet balance to a bank: $2 fee. E-wallet credits expire 12 months after top-up; no refund on expiry.
uParcel is GST-registered; GST applies to the platform commission (20% of the delivery fee).

sop.title: Minimum pickup window by service (customer side)
sop.keywords: pickup window time frame interval 4 hours 3 hours 1 hour how long
body: Same Day, Next Day, 2-Way Round Trip and Specific Slot: pickup window of at least 4 hrs.
3 Hours Express: at least 3 hrs. 1 Hour Rush: at least 1 hr.
Agents can't change the time with the customer; they must not accept jobs they can't complete on time.

sop.title: Prohibited items and packing
sop.keywords: prohibited items what can i send explosives firearms drugs cash passport live animals pack packing fragile
body: Not accepted: explosives, firearms, drugs, flammable/hazardous materials, live animals, cash and cards, passports/government IDs, original documents without copies, parcels worth over $2,000.
Senders must pack and seal items securely; mark fragile items and use bubble wrap.
Need a delivery order (DO) returned? Book a 2-Way Round Trip or include a pre-stamped return envelope.

sop.title: Published flat rates by weight and size
sop.keywords: price rate how much cost weight size kg cm flat rate published 1kg 5kg 25kg
body: Published flat rates (SGD, before GST): 1 kg / 60 cm $22 · 5 kg / 80 cm $24 · 8 kg / 100 cm $26 · 10 kg / 120 cm $28 · 15 kg / 140 cm $30 · 20 kg / 160 cm $33 · 25 kg / 200 cm $36.
Size is L + W + H. Rates include ERP, tolls and parking.
A temporary $1 fuel surcharge applies on all published delivery rates.
The website does not say which service type this table is for. Confirm the exact price in the booking app before quoting.

sop.title: Area, distance, night and waiting-time surcharges
sop.keywords: surcharge cbd city tuas sentosa changi airport airline house distance 18km night waiting time per minute postal code
body: City area (CBD, Orchard, Downtown — postal codes 01–08, 17–19, 22–23): $2.
Entry fee — Sentosa, Changi Airport, Changi Aviation Centre, Tuas South 636/637: $10 (Sentosa entry fee also payable).
Changi Airline House: $15.
Distance over 18 km (pickup to drop-off): $3 (plus a $1 long-distance increase).
Night delivery (bookings 11pm–7am; only 1 Hour Rush available): $15.
Waiting time after the first 10 minutes: $0.40 per minute.

sop.title: Tracking, proof of delivery, receipts and records
sop.keywords: track tracking number sms link proof delivered receipt invoice waybill print history report saved 60 days
body: Every job has a tracking number; customers can track at uparcel.sg/track or via the SMS tracking link.
Customer gets phone and email notification on delivery, with recipient name, signature and time.
Receipt is emailed after delivery. Waybill: Manage Deliveries → Print Waybill.
Orders are saved for 60 days (e.g. posted 1 Apr, viewable until 31 May).

sop.title: Under-declared or oversized parcels (customer side)
sop.keywords: under-declared oversized too big heavier refuse 50% refund maximum size 25kg 200cm
body: Maximum size: under 200 cm (L + W + H) and 25 kg. Larger items should be split into two parcels and booked to the same address (bulk discount applies).
If a parcel is under-declared, the agent may refuse it. If refused, the customer gets a 50% refund of the original fee.
Agent may instead deliver with the sender's written approval and upload a weight/size photo; the extra charge is then applied.
